title: Rock Paper Scissors
description:
```
Best of how many rounds? 5
Round 1 — (r)ock, (p)aper, (s)cissors: r
Computer chose scissors. You win the round!
Score: You 1 - 0 Computer
...
 You win the match 3-1!
```
requirements: Function `int decideWinner(char player, char computer)` returning 1/0/-1
Stop early when someone can't be caught
stretch: Rock-Paper-Scissors-Lizard-Spock; a "cheating" AI that tracks your most frequent move.
